I've finally finished making custom spell cards for every spell in the 5E PHB and Elemental Evil supplement. That's 404 cards.

It was a big job.

For newbie me, the wall of text surrounding casting classes was too much to slog through, so when I saw RPG Booster's Pathfinder cards, I knew I needed them for D&D. You can see my first draft is almost a complete imitation of their work, but I refined it into my own style by the end — I even commissioned original artwork (thanks @mustashleigh) for the icons and learned Illustrator to make the back.

The best thing about D&D is how unique every table is. My players roll with custom spell cards now, but next month they'll be rolling with custom loot cards too, and God knows what a month on from that.

If you have ever wanted a custom resource for your game, you should make it. I really hope you do. If you don't know how to use design software, this is the perfect way to learn. I learned Adobe InDesign and Illustrator — you can too.

Make things and share them, friends.
I made custom spell cards for every 5E spell
